season.evidence: Web search: guidebook-derived and Mountaineers/WTA pages say late July through September once the basin melts out; snow and a frozen Foggy Lake persist into July; October ascents are possible but snow returns. Stored Jul-Sep kept; usable window with margin is Jun-Oct.

track.why: Our catalog holds exactly one route on this peak (the standard scramble from Foggy Lake); Aug 16 round trip from the Barlow Pass trailhead (start/end ~83 m from our pin), summited within 6 m of our summit pin, report describes the normal route and class 3 summit block.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Aug 28, complete, summit within 3 m, single route on peak; equally valid alternate.
Jul 6 link-up with Del Campo Peak: highest point is 921 m from Gothic's summit, so it is not a Gothic-only track.
Aug 2017 SE Ridge, complete, but no elevation data or report to confirm summit proximity.
Sep 2017 East Face logged; not a complete round trip (ends 5 km from the trailhead pin).
Oct 9 start from Foggy Pass, partial track.

facts.text: In early July, snow patches remain at the saddle above Foggy Lake, and a moat can open along the rock above the snowfields
ice axe (early to mid July; snow-free by mid-August)
In early July, an easier but chossy class 2 alternative leaves the base of the summit block and drops to climber's left below the ridge; it crosses a moderate-angle snow traverse that month.
A hidden notch gives the easy way onto the summit block, with only one or two class 3 moves; the rock there is solid.

notes: Single route on the peak, so blank logged routes are acceptable where the track follows the Foggy Lake line and the summit block. Our trailhead pin is 60 m from the track starts; no pin change needed.
